# GitHub Pages
> Websites for you and your projects, hosted directly from your GitHub repository.

GitHub Pages lets users and organizations publish static websites directly from GitHub repositories, with support for custom domains, Jekyll, and project or account sites.

## GitHub Pages
- [GitHub Pages Home](https://pages.github.com/): Overview of GitHub Pages hosting for personal, organization, and project websites.
- [Create a Site from Scratch](https://pages.github.com/): Landing page for starting a new GitHub Pages site.
- [GitHub Pages Documentation](https://docs.github.com/en/pages): Central documentation for building, configuring, and publishing GitHub Pages sites.
- [About GitHub Pages](https://docs.github.com/en/pages/getting-started-with-github-pages/about-github-pages): Explains how GitHub Pages works, site types, and publishing sources.
- [Creating a GitHub Pages Site](https://docs.github.com/en/pages/getting-started-with-github-pages/creating-a-github-pages-site): Step-by-step guide to creating and publishing a Pages site.
- [Troubleshooting 404 Errors](https://docs.github.com/en/pages/getting-started-with-github-pages/troubleshooting-404-errors-for-github-pages-sites): Common causes and fixes for Pages site routing and publishing issues.

## Getting Started
- [Quickstart for GitHub Pages](https://docs.github.com/en/pages/quickstart): Fast path to create and publish a Pages site from a repository.
- [Configuring a Publishing Source](https://docs.github.com/en/pages/getting-started-with-github-pages/configuring-a-publishing-source-for-your-github-pages-site): Choose branches or workflows as the source for site deployment.
- [Creating a Repository for Your Site](https://docs.github.com/en/pages/getting-started-with-github-pages/creating-a-github-pages-site): Set up account, organization, or project repositories for Pages.
- [Using a Static Site Generator](https://docs.github.com/en/pages/getting-started-with-github-pages/using-static-site-generators-with-github-pages): Publish sites built with supported static site generation workflows.
- [Viewing Your Published Site](https://docs.github.com/en/pages/getting-started-with-github-pages/viewing-your-github-pages-site-after-your-site-has-been-published): Learn where your site is hosted after deployment.

## Custom Domains and DNS
- [About Custom Domains and GitHub Pages](https://docs.github.com/en/pages/configuring-a-custom-domain-for-your-github-pages-site/about-custom-domains-and-github-pages): Overview of custom domain support, DNS requirements, and limitations.
- [Configuring a Custom Domain](https://docs.github.com/en/pages/configuring-a-custom-domain-for-your-github-pages-site/configuring-a-custom-domain-for-your-github-pages-site): Connect a custom domain to a GitHub Pages site.
- [Managing a Custom Domain](https://docs.github.com/en/pages/configuring-a-custom-domain-for-your-github-pages-site/managing-a-custom-domain-for-your-github-pages-site): Update, verify, or remove custom domain settings.
- [Verifying Your Custom Domain](https://docs.github.com/en/pages/configuring-a-custom-domain-for-your-github-pages-site/verifying-your-custom-domain-for-github-pages): Verify domain ownership to improve security and prevent takeover.
- [Securing Your Site with HTTPS](https://docs.github.com/en/pages/getting-started-with-github-pages/securing-your-github-pages-site-with-https): Enable HTTPS for Pages sites and understand certificate provisioning.
- [Troubleshooting Custom Domains and HTTPS](https://docs.github.com/en/pages/configuring-a-custom-domain-for-your-github-pages-site/troubleshooting-custom-domains-and-github-pages): Diagnose DNS, certificate, and domain configuration problems.

## Jekyll and Site Content
- [About GitHub Pages and Jekyll](https://docs.github.com/en/pages/setting-up-a-github-pages-site-with-jekyll/about-github-pages-and-jekyll): Explains built-in Jekyll support and how Pages processes content.
- [Creating a GitHub Pages Site with Jekyll](https://docs.github.com/en/pages/setting-up-a-github-pages-site-with-jekyll/creating-a-github-pages-site-with-jekyll): Build and publish a Jekyll-powered Pages site.
- [Testing Your GitHub Pages Site Locally with Jekyll](https://docs.github.com/en/pages/setting-up-a-github-pages-site-with-jekyll/testing-your-github-pages-site-locally-with-jekyll): Run and preview a Pages-compatible Jekyll site locally.
- [Adding Content to Your GitHub Pages Site Using Jekyll](https://docs.github.com/en/pages/setting-up-a-github-pages-site-with-jekyll/adding-content-to-your-github-pages-site-using-jekyll): Create pages, posts, and site structure with Jekyll conventions.
- [Front Matter](https://jekyllrb.com/docs/front-matter/): Define page metadata and layout settings for Jekyll content.
- [Jekyll Documentation](https://jekyllrb.com/docs/): Official Jekyll guides for configuration, themes, collections, and content.

## Themes and Appearance
- [About Themes](https://docs.github.com/en/pages/setting-up-a-github-pages-site-with-jekyll/adding-a-theme-to-your-github-pages-site-using-jekyll): Overview of applying themes to Jekyll-based Pages sites.
- [Adding a Theme to Your GitHub Pages Site Using Jekyll](https://docs.github.com/en/pages/setting-up-a-github-pages-site-with-jekyll/adding-a-theme-to-your-github-pages-site-using-jekyll): Configure a supported theme for a Pages site.
- [Creating a Custom 404 Page](https://docs.github.com/en/pages/getting-started-with-github-pages/creating-a-custom-404-page-for-your-github-pages-site): Add a custom not-found page for better site navigation.
- [Customizing Your Theme](https://jekyllrb.com/docs/themes/): Modify layouts, includes, and assets for Jekyll themes.
- [GitHub Pages Dependency Versions](https://pages.github.com/versions/): Lists gem and dependency versions used by the Pages build environment.

## GitHub Actions and Deployment
- [Using Custom Workflows with GitHub Pages](https://docs.github.com/en/pages/getting-started-with-github-pages/using-custom-workflows-with-github-pages): Deploy Pages sites using GitHub Actions workflows.
- [Configuring a Publishing Source](https://docs.github.com/en/pages/getting-started-with-github-pages/configuring-a-publishing-source-for-your-github-pages-site): Set branch or workflow-based publishing for Pages deployments.
- [GitHub Actions Documentation](https://docs.github.com/en/actions): Reference and guides for workflow automation on GitHub.
- [Deployments and Environments](https://docs.github.com/en/actions/deployment): Manage deployment targets and protections in GitHub Actions.
- [Workflow Syntax for GitHub Actions](https://docs.github.com/en/actions/using-workflows/workflow-syntax-for-github-actions): YAML syntax reference for defining Pages deployment workflows.

## API and Platform
- [GitHub REST API](https://docs.github.com/rest): REST API reference for repositories, pages, deployments, and related resources.
- [GitHub GraphQL API](https://docs.github.com/en/graphql): GraphQL API reference for querying GitHub data programmatically.
- [Repositories REST API](https://docs.github.com/en/rest/repos): Repository endpoints relevant to Pages configuration and content.
- [Pages REST API](https://docs.github.com/en/rest/pages): API endpoints for GitHub Pages sites, builds, and deployments.
- [GitHub CLI Manual](https://cli.github.com/manual/): Command-line interface documentation for working with GitHub repositories and workflows.
- [GitHub Developer Documentation](https://docs.github.com/en/developers): Platform docs for integrations, apps, APIs, and automation.

## Support and Troubleshooting
- [GitHub Pages Documentation](https://docs.github.com/en/pages): Main support hub for Pages setup, configuration, and maintenance.
- [Troubleshooting 404 Errors](https://docs.github.com/en/pages/getting-started-with-github-pages/troubleshooting-404-errors-for-github-pages-sites): Resolve common site path, branch, and publishing issues.
- [Troubleshooting Custom Domains](https://docs.github.com/en/pages/configuring-a-custom-domain-for-your-github-pages-site/troubleshooting-custom-domains-and-github-pages): Fix DNS, HTTPS, and domain verification problems.
- [GitHub Support](https://support.github.com): Contact support and browse help resources for GitHub products.
- [GitHub Status](https://www.githubstatus.com/): Service status and incident history for GitHub systems.
- [Security](https://github.com/security): Security resources, advisories, and reporting information for GitHub.

## Company and Resources
- [GitHub Blog](https://github.blog): Product updates, engineering posts, and announcements from GitHub.
- [GitHub Training](https://training.github.com): Learning resources and training for GitHub workflows and collaboration.
- [About GitHub](https://github.com/about): Company overview, product information, and organizational details.
- [Terms of Service](https://docs.github.com/en/github/site-policy/github-terms-of-service): Legal terms governing use of GitHub services.
- [Privacy Statement](https://docs.github.com/en/github/site-policy/github-privacy-statement): Details on data handling and privacy practices.
- [Contact GitHub](https://support.github.com): Support and contact entry point for GitHub users.
